title: Nibify Catalog v2
description: The components an agent may use in a Nibify surface. A restricted, A2UI-conformant subset of the A2UI Basic catalog (specification v1.0): the names and the semantics are A2UI's, the selection is Nibify's. Every component carries the catalog version it was introduced in under 'metadata.extensions.app_nibify.since', which is what lets the server derive a message's minCatalogVersion. See README.md.
instructions:
A Nibify surface is drawn inside a phone app for the one person who answers it. Use only the components and the two functions this catalog defines: anything else makes the surface invalid, and it is rejected before it reaches the phone.

## Structure

Components are a flat list with unique ids; hierarchy is by reference ('children' is an array of ids, 'child' is a single id). Exactly one component MUST have the id 'root'.

## Required properties

Include ALL required properties of every component, even inside a template or when the value will be bound to data. A bound value is written { "@path": "/pointer" }.

- 'Text' needs 'text'; 'Image' needs 'url'.
- 'Button' needs 'child' and 'action'.
- 'TextField' and 'CheckBox' need 'label' and 'value'; 'ChoicePicker' needs 'options' and 'value'.
- 'Slider' needs 'value' and 'max'; 'DateTimeInput' needs 'value'.

## Headings are Markdown

'Text.variant' is 'body' or 'caption', nothing else. A heading is a Text whose 'text' starts with '#' to '#####', for example "text": "## Invoice to approve". Write headings as literal text: no function can add the markers to a bound value.

## Validation is '@checks' on a TextField

Only a 'TextField' takes '@checks'. Each check's 'condition' calls 'required' or 'regex', and its 'message' is what the person reads when the check fails. 'regex' matches anywhere in the value unless the pattern is anchored with '^' and '$'.

```json
[
  {
    "id": "iban",
    "component": "TextField",
    "label": "IBAN",
    "value": { "@path": "/iban" },
    "@checks": [
      {
        "condition": { "@call": "required", "args": { "value": { "@path": "/iban" } } },
        "message": "An IBAN is required."
      },
      {
        "condition": {
          "@call": "regex",
          "args": { "value": { "@path": "/iban" }, "pattern": "^[A-Z]{2}[0-9]{2}[A-Z0-9]{11,30}$" }
        },
        "message": "That is not an IBAN."
      }
    ]
  }
]
```

## No other functions

'required' and 'regex' are the only functions, and they belong inside '@checks'. Text cannot be concatenated or formatted at render time: send the final string, or bind a single path.

## No form component

A form is a pattern, not a component. Build it as a Column or Card of inputs bound to the data model, plus a Button whose 'action.event.context' collects the paths of those fields.

## One selection component

'ChoicePicker' covers radio groups, dropdowns, selects and multi-selects. There is no Select, Radio or Dropdown.

## The lock screen carries the decision

Anything answerable without typing should also exist as a notification quickAction with the same action name. Anything needing structured input (a note, a choice, a date, a slider) is answered by opening the app.

text.description: The text content to display. While simple Markdown formatting is supported (i.e. without HTML, images, or links), utilizing dedicated UI components is generally preferred for a richer and more structured presentation.

variant.description: A hint for the base text style.

url.description: The URL of the image to display.

fit.description: Specifies how the image should be resized to fit its container. This corresponds to the CSS 'object-fit' property.

variant.description: A hint for the image size and style.

name.description: The name of the icon to display.

Row.description: A layout component that arranges its children horizontally. To create a grid layout, nest Columns within this Row.

children.description: Defines the children. Use an array of strings for a fixed set of children, or a template object to generate children from a data list. Children cannot be defined inline, they must be referred to by ID.

justify.description: Defines the arrangement of children along the main axis (horizontally). Use 'spaceBetween' to push items to the edges, or 'start'/'end'/'center' to pack them together.

align.description: Defines the alignment of children along the cross axis (vertically). This is similar to the CSS 'align-items' property, but uses camelCase values (e.g., 'start').

Column.description: A layout component that arranges its children vertically. To create a grid layout, nest Rows within this Column.

children.description: Defines the children. Use an array of strings for a fixed set of children, or a template object to generate children from a data list. Children cannot be defined inline, they must be referred to by ID.

justify.description: Defines the arrangement of children along the main axis (vertically). Use 'spaceBetween' to push items to the edges (e.g. header at top, footer at bottom), or 'start'/'end'/'center' to pack them together.

align.description: Defines the alignment of children along the cross axis (horizontally). This is similar to the CSS 'align-items' property.

children.description: Defines the children. Use an array of strings for a fixed set of children, or a template object to generate children from a data list.

direction.description: The direction in which the list items are laid out.

align.description: Defines the alignment of children along the cross axis.

child.description: The ID of the single child component to be rendered inside the card. To display multiple elements, you MUST wrap them in a layout component (like Column or Row) and pass that container's ID here. Do NOT pass multiple IDs or a non-existent ID.
The ID of the child component. Use a 'Text' component for a labeled button. Only use an 'Icon' if the requirements explicitly ask for an icon-only button.

variant.description: A hint for the button style. If omitted, a default button style is used. 'primary' indicates this is the main call-to-action button. 'borderless' means the button has no visual border or background, making its child content appear like a clickable link.

label.description: The text label for the input field.

value.description: The value of the text field. Always a string, under every variant: a 'number' field bound to '/importo' answers '84.50' and not 84.5.

variant.description: The type of input field to display. 'number' chooses the numeric keyboard and the characters the field accepts; it does not change the type of the value, which stays a string.

label.description: The text to display next to the checkbox.

value.description: The current state of the checkbox (true for checked, false for unchecked).

ChoicePicker.description: A component that allows selecting one or more options from a list. This is the only selection component: it covers radio groups, dropdowns, selects and multi-selects.

label.description: The label for the group of options.

variant.description: A hint for how the choice picker should be displayed and behave.

options.description: The list of available options to choose from.

label.description: The text to display for this option.

value.description: The stable value associated with this option.
The list of currently selected values. This should be bound to a string array in the data model.

displayStyle.description: How the options are laid out: checkbox stacks them as full-width rows, chips wraps them as compact pills. It does not decide the mark drawn beside an option — variant does.

filterable.description: If true, displays a search input to filter the options.

min.description: The minimum value of the slider.

max.description: The maximum value of the slider.

value.description: The current value of the slider.
The selected date and/or time value in ISO 8601 format. If not yet set, initialize with an empty string.

enableDate.description: If true, allows the user to select a date.

enableTime.description: If true, allows the user to select a time.

min.description: The minimum allowed date/time in ISO 8601 format.

max.description: The maximum allowed date/time in ISO 8601 format.

label.description: The text label for the input field.

required.description: Checks that the value is not null, undefined, or empty.

regex.description: Checks that the value matches a regular expression string.

pattern.description: The regular expression to search for in the value. Uses the A2UI regex dialect: a portable subset of ECMAScript pattern syntax in Unicode mode with no flags. Matching is case-sensitive, '.' excludes line terminators, and '^' and '$' match only at the ends of the value. Backreferences, lookbehind, named groups and '\p{...}' are not allowed. Patterns longer than 256 code points or that could backtrack catastrophically are rejected.

Weight.description: The relative weight of this component within a Row or Column. This is similar to the CSS 'flex-grow' property. Note: this may ONLY be set when the component is a direct descendant of a Row or Column.

StringOrPath.description: A string, or a binding to one in the data model. No function call: in this catalog a function belongs inside the @checks of a TextField.

NumberOrPath.description: A number, or a binding to one in the data model. No function call: in this catalog a function belongs inside the @checks of a TextField.

BooleanOrPath.description: A boolean, or a binding to one in the data model. No function call: in this catalog a function belongs inside the @checks of a TextField.

StringListOrPath.description: A list of strings, or a binding to one in the data model. No function call: in this catalog a function belongs inside the @checks of a TextField.

ContextValue.description: A literal value, or a binding to one in the data model. No function call: in this catalog a function belongs inside the @checks of a TextField.

Action.description: Triggers an agent-side event, the only kind of action in this catalog. No function call: in this catalog a function belongs inside the @checks of a TextField.

event.description: The event to dispatch to the agent.

name.description: The name of the action to be dispatched to the agent.

userMessage.description: An optional human-readable message describing the action performed by the user, resolved by the renderer and included in the outbound action message.

context.description: A JSON object containing the key-value pairs for the action context. Values can be literals or paths. Use literal values unless the value must be dynamically bound to the data model. Do NOT use paths for static IDs.

Accessibility.description: What the envelope's @accessibility may carry in this catalog. No function call: in this catalog a function belongs inside the @checks of a TextField.
